column1: # Public data files the app's demos, recipes and checks read (suite ADR 0006: public data only, each with a DOI and a
# GPL-compatible licence). tools/lib/fetch-public-data.sh reads this; .github/workflows/public-data.yml runs it on GitHub's
# Linux runner (workflow_dispatch), so no session opens zenodo.org or datadryad.org itself. Nothing here is committed:
# the files land under References/public-data/ (gitignored), the run's `public-data` artifact and its Actions cache.
# One file per line, tab-separated: destination (under References/public-data/), hash, URL, licence, DOI.
# The hash is `sha256:<hex>`, or `md5:<hex>` where the publisher states only an MD5 (Zenodo's own file checksum, which
# pyxem's data registry repeats); each run prints every file's sha256, so an md5 entry is moved to sha256 by the PR that
# first uses the file. docs/data-sources.md names each file's source and citation once the app uses it.
# The first entry is the 2.3 demo pattern's source (#804, Q21): pyxem's twinned GaAs nanowire 4D-STEM scan, pyxem data
